details: This package is a self-declared dependency-confusion proof of concept. Its postinstall hook runs node beacon.cjs, which resolves and POSTs a JSON body over HTTPS (TLS verification disabled) to hxxps://vmi3699893[.]contaboserver[.]net:8787/_ah/dc with an x-beacon-package header naming the package. The beaconed body contains only install metadata: the package name, os.hostname(), the install path (__dirname), process.cwd(), an npm/'+process.version user-agent string and the protocol. No environment variables, tokens, credentials, wallet data or file contents are read or transmitted; the only files touched are the package's own four files (beacon.cjs, index.js, README.md, package.json).
